component: patcher (waves: characterise -> fix -> verify -> reconcile -> integrate)
ground_truth_set: juice-shop patcher subset-04 (10 bugs, both oracles verified before admission)
engine: v2 wave engine; task_granularity=file, task_concurrency=2, gate_concurrency=2
notes: Aggregate only; located per-case evidence lives in the answer-key repo per the publishing rule. QUALIFICATIONS, each material: (1) the bug report for this run carried the vulnerability and reproduction prose fields, which were removed afterwards - no run made after commit 28695a4 is comparable. (2) 3 of the 5 NO_FIX are one unit whose fix was demonstrably correct - exploit probe blocked and workflow test green on all 5 rounds - and was reverted because its regression net contained tests that require attack-dependent behaviour; policy.on_exhausted has since changed to keep_best. (3) WPR is measured over the vetted 865-block net; an independent full-suite capture against the pristine base found 8 blocks lost in a unit test that pins a pre-fix value, outside that net, so WPR 1.0 means 'no damage within the vetted net', not 'no damage'. (4) node_modules is unpinned - the target app sets package-lock=false - so cross-run comparison is unsound. (5) the run's blind audit flagged contaminated on a single DENIED network egress attempt; out_of_tree and answer_key_pattern were both 0 and nothing was fetched, so blindness held; the classifier treats denied attempts as contaminating and has not been corrected.
